0022600175.text: Boston, 5-2 overall and 4-0 at home, is 2nd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, and 3rd in the East after a loss in its most recent game, with this being its eighth game of the 2026-27 season. Milwaukee is 1-6 and on a three-game losing streak, sitting 5th in the Central, 5 games back, and 14th in the East, with a 0-3 road record. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Celtics won their 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 133-101 win in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, and Paul George is day-to-day with rest and is a game-time decision.
